006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import java.util.List;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.StaticMetapathException;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IIntegerItem;
019import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IQNameItem;
020import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IItemType;
021import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
022import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
023
024/**
025 * /** Implements <a href=
026 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-function-lookup">fn:function-lookup</a>
027 * functions.
028 */
029public final class FnFunctionLookup {
030  @NonNull
031  private static final String NAME = "function-lookup";
032
033  @NonNull
034  static final IFunction SIGNATURE = IFunction.builder()
035      .name(NAME)
036      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
037      .deterministic()
038      .contextIndependent()
039      .focusIndependent()
040      .argument(IArgument.builder()
041          .name("name")
042          .type(IQNameItem.type())
043          .one()
044          .build())
045      .argument(IArgument.builder()
046          .name("arity")
047          .type(IIntegerItem.type())
048          .one()
049          .build())
050      .returnType(IItemType.function())
051      .returnZeroOrOne()
052      .functionHandler(FnFunctionLookup::execute)
053      .build();
054
055  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
056  @NonNull
057  private static ISequence<IFunction> execute(@NonNull IFunction function,
058      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
059      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
060      IItem focus) {
061    IQNameItem name = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0).getFirstItem(true)));
062    IIntegerItem arity = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(1).getFirstItem(true)));
063    IFunction matchingFunction = null;
064
065    try {
066      matchingFunction = dynamicContext.lookupFunction(
067          name.toEnhancedQName(),
068          arity.toIntValueExact());
069    } catch (StaticMetapathException ex) {
070      if (ex.getErrorCode().getCode() != StaticMetapathException.NO_FUNCTION_MATCH) {
071        // this is something other than a non-match
072        throw ex;
073      }
074    }
075
076    return ISequence.of(matchingFunction);
077  }
078
079  private FnFunctionLookup() {
080    // disable construction
081  }
082}
